race.comment: WESTERN JET (2) had no luck two back before missing by 3L as the race favourite in a stronger race last time out. Tsang hops on board now claiming 3kg and the blinkers go on for the first time. He shaped as a progressive type earlier this campaign and can get back on track now. SILENT DIVA (1) missed by 0.7L at this track and trip 11 days ago in a stronger race and now lands here third-up into the campaign. Will carry the big weight, but she's a handy type and the winkers go on for the first time. Can roll forward and give a bold sight. COSMIC GEM (4) ended last campaign on a winning note and hasn't taken a backwards step judging by his latest trial. McGruddy sticks from that outing and the form out of his win prior to the break was super. Can pick up from where he left off. WHITE HOT (9) was too good from the front last time out and now gets Pike on board. Can repeat the dose without surprising. LEMMOR FILOU (7) was too good last start and has to be included on the back of that.
